title: Switch SME Electricity to Origin Energy and get a $300 Gift Card @ Econnex
body:
Deal: Switch SME Electricity to Origin Energy and get a $300 Gift Card @ Econnex

[Jjklark] I see "no available plans" when I click through just for electricity.
[dsiritz] Be aware if you don’t have a smart meter and transition to a new supplier from Origin, they will do an egregiously large over estimate and send the bill to debt collection without any negotiations. I submitted a reading with the exact kind of photo they needed timestamped on the day of changing providers and got nowhere.
Not the first time I’ve experienced dogsh*t customer service from Origin.
Night and day difference dealing with Nectar.
[ganjadeals] Fair bit of clicking around just to get " No Available Offers ".
[Robot16] I have a plan but I have been a customer with their internet plan.. Need to check if I am still eligible
[Robot16] @manyo can you confirm if I had internet with origin recently am I eligible for the deal?
[Rogue01] No available plans. Moreton Bay, QLD.
Has anyone found an eligible area? Seems like an unobtainable deal so far….
